about: Reviewed notices for the desktop app's third-party code. Keys are exact versions, so an update fails the notice collection until the entry is reviewed again. packages: locked crates (desktop/Cargo.lock, macOS and Linux) that publish no notice file of their own, read by scripts/dependency-licenses.py --supplement. license repeats the declared license; source says where the notice was checked against upstream, normally the repository's license files at the commit the version was published from (.cargo_vcs_info.json). notices_from uses the root notice files of one exact locked package from the same repository. standard_text uses <id>.txt in this directory for one license the package is offered under, preceded by the upstream copyright lines in copyright; MIT, BSD, ISC and Zlib texts cannot be used without them. MPL-2.0.txt is the text published with cssparser 0.37.0 (Servo). npm: packages of desktop/package-lock.json read by desktop/scripts/third-party-licenses.py. Every OFL font needs an entry, which lists the notice files that carry its copyright and Reserved Font Name statements and adds a reviewed upstream notice where the package's own is incomplete. bundler_runtime names a development-only package whose own code the production build emits into dist, as found in a source-mapped build; its notices are added and the build tool's version is pinned. excerpt keeps only the leading section of a notice file whose remainder covers code that is not emitted.

rolldown 1.2.14.bundler_runtime: dist/assets/index-*.js starts with two pieces that Rolldown's native binding writes: its module runtime helper __commonJSMin (crates/rolldown/src/runtime/runtime-base.js, adapted from esbuild; THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE carries the esbuild and Rollup notices) and the module-preload polyfill of its builtin vite-module-preload-polyfill plugin, a port of the polyfill Vite adapted from es-module-shims (guybedford/es-module-shims LICENSE, the upstream notice below).
rolldown 1.2.14.source: in a source-mapped production build (vite 8.3.4, rolldown 1.2.14) the only code without a source was these two pieces and the wrappers Rolldown writes around bundled modules; Vite 8.3.4 delegates the polyfill to rolldown/experimental, and Vite 7's modulePreloadPolyfill.ts names its es-module-shims origin.

vite 8.3.4.bundler_runtime: the module-preload polyfill Rolldown emits is a port of Vite's own polyfill code, so the Vite core license of LICENSE.md applies to it; the rest of that file covers dependencies bundled into Vite's JavaScript, which is not emitted.
vite 8.3.4.source: in a source-mapped production build (vite 8.3.4, rolldown 1.2.14) the only code without a source was the Rolldown runtime helper, the module-preload polyfill and the module wrappers Rolldown writes around bundled modules.
